title: MyPerfectVanilla
body:
# MyPerfectVanilla (MPV)

THE VANILLA EXPERIENCE, POLISHED TO PERFECTION.

A seamless blend of peak performance, breathtaking visuals, and essential quality-of-life enhancements.

--- ## Overview MyPerfectVanilla (MPV) is a meticulously curated modpack designed for players who love the core spirit of Vanilla Minecraft but crave modern performance, breathtaking visuals, and seamless quality-of-life improvements. Instead of overwhelming the game with complex tech trees or custom magic systems, MPV focuses on polishing what makes Minecraft great: exploration, building, and immersion. --- ## Key Features * **Next-Gen Performance:** Powered by Sodium, Lithium, and modern optimization engines to maximize your FPS and eliminate stuttering, even with high render distances. * **Stunning Visuals:** Fully compatible with iris shaders and features custom, subtle resource tweaks that enhance textures, leaves, and water without breaking the vanilla art style. * **Quality of Life:** Includes seamless inventory management, advanced tooltips, an intuitive map/minimap system, and a zoom key. * **Immersive Audio:** Enhanced ambient sounds and directional audio bring caves, forests, and oceans to life. * **Pure Vanilla Compatibility:** Built to work perfectly on standard vanilla multiplayer servers. Play with your friends anywhere! --- ## Installation Guide Getting started is quick and easy: 1. **Download a Launcher:** We recommend using the Modrinth App or CurseForge. 2. **Search for MPV:** Type "MyPerfectVanilla" into the search bar. 3. **Install & Play:** Click "Install", wait for the assets to download, and hit "Play"! > Tip: For the absolute best experience, make sure to enable your preferred Shader Pack in the Video Settings menu after launching! --- ## Community & Support Got feedback, found a bug, or want to share your builds? Join our community! * **Report Bugs:** Visit our Issue Tracker to log any performance drops or crashes. * **Suggestions:** Have a favorite vanilla+ mod? Let us know on our Issues page! ---
